data.title: Adding Two-Digit Numbers with Regrouping
data.description: Learn how to carry the ten when the ones column adds up to 10 or more.

challenges.hint: Count your ones blocks. If you have 10 or more, trade 10 ones for 1 tens rod!
challenges.narration: Whoa, 7 + 5 = 12! That's more than 9, so we need to regroup!

challenges.hint: Add the ones first. 8 + 4 gives you a new ten to carry over!
challenges.narration: Let's add the ones column together. Remember to carry the extra ten!

challenges.hint: 9 plus 6 makes 15. Write down the 5 and carry the 1 ten.
challenges.narration: Another chance to practice carrying the ten. You've got this!

regroupingSteps.narration: We traded 10 ones cubes for 1 tens rod. Now we have 2 ones left and 1 new ten!

wordProblemContext.imagePrompt: Friendly cartoon children collecting objects together in a bright classroom.
wordProblemContext.story: Students are gathering school supplies and putting them together in boxes. Let's find the total amount by adding them up!
